elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: Section 8.1A expressly retains a minimum monthly fee commitment, including the Monthly Base Fee.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Customer must pay a true-up when actual usage-based charges are below the committed amount and must obtain all Services included in the Monthly Base Fee.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: Section 8.1A limits the minimum monthly fee commitment to the then-current twelve-month period of the Term.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Section 8.1A permits Customer to reduce the commitment upon thirty days' prior written notice to M&I.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: Section 8.1A requires payment of the difference as a true-up and expressly states that no penalty or shortfall charge applies.
